$provenance.target: a prepared test environment's HQ, the standing owner of the test organisation; fixtures in mate-hq docs/operations/alfa.md
$provenance.command: GOTOOLCHAIN=local go run ./cmd/live --hq <test environment> --profile <a second person's profile> --owner-profile test-rw --answers-from <journey receipts> --record-answers <dir>
steps: On a prepared test environment run the manual journey: journey run --manual production-create-attach --env <env> --out <journey receipts>. It makes what it needs and removes it.

Have the browser profiles of a second person of the test organisation and the standing owner (test-rw) signed in to Zerops, set HQ_LIVE_PROFILES to the directory holding them, and run GOTOOLCHAIN=local go run ./cmd/live --hq <test environment> --profile <a second person's profile> --owner-profile test-rw --answers-from <journey receipts> --record-answers <dir>.
The writer reads production-create-attach/test-rw-hq-frames.json and takes the navigation delivery showing the run's first environment operation environment.running.

It writes the public form of the answers recorder (mate-hq docs/architecture/testing.md, Answers for the public repository) and refuses to write when the file still contains the two persons' organisations' ids and names, either person's user id, the HQ host or the Zerops app domain.
